title: ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC)
subtitle: An entry-level security certification, taught from zero — no work experience assumed
audience: For self-paced learners preparing for the ISC2 CC exam on the 2026-09 outline, with no prior security job required. Five modules follow the five exam domains, each with a guided lab and a closing practice lesson, and every lesson exists in English and Thai with identical checkpoint answers. Labs are defensive only and run on your own computer, a free sandbox or a simulated surface.
outcomes: Apply the security principles the exam tests: CIA, authentication and authorisation, risk, controls, ethics and governance basics (Domain 1, 24%)
Explain business continuity, disaster recovery and incident response concepts and how they fit together (Domain 2, 17.3%)
Describe access control concepts — physical and logical — and the identity lifecycle (Domain 3, 20%)
Recognise network and cloud security fundamentals: threats, infrastructure, secure design and cloud service models (Domain 4, 21.3%)
Carry out security operations: data security, hardening, best practices and awareness (Domain 5, 17.3%)
Review the whole outline in the capstone and plan your exam day
